text:
The response has two factual errors. It says the resample was taken on 9 October, but it was taken on 6 October; 9 October is when the result came back. It also says the contractor "visited monthly and missed this fault during those visits," which reverses the report's account: the pump failed in mid-September and was not picked up because the monthly visit was missed. It omits the fortnightly sampling and the breach-based cost recovery basis, and it is about 230 words, nearly double the 120-word limit. The core decision (approve $4,800) and the interim weekly checks are clear and correctly stated, but the errors and length failure weigh heavily.

Score: 3
